findings.message: PUT overshoots setpoint by up to +20.1 kPa (peak PUT 101.3 kPa) near 3006 rpm; primary zone — transient spike at 3006-3006 rpm: mean +20.1 / peak +20.1 kPa over 0.04 s (pull 6)
findings.title: Boost tracking

findings.message: settled-WOT lambda runs lean by +0.068 (above the +0.05 High line)
findings.title: Lambda

findings.message: PUT runs 4.3 kPa under setpoint on average (peak -7.3 kPa) for 4.40 s from 3594-6027 rpm (pull 6); the wastegate integral winds from -1.2% to 14.5% across the zone while the final command sits 13.9 points above the position feedforward (`wg_pos_base`) — the closed loop is carrying a shortfall the position feedforward is leaving, so the feedforward is commanding too little there
findings.title: Boost shortfall

findings.message: fuel headroom watch: worst DI rail sag -9.5 bar; LPFP duty peaks 79.0%; HPFP eff. volume peaks 98.5%
findings.title: Rail pressure and pump headroom

findings.message: heat/turbo watch: turbo speed peaks 204 krpm; IAT peaks 33 C; coolant peaks 102 C; oil peaks 113 C
findings.title: Turbo and heat

findings.message: demanded manifold-pressure setpoint peak (map_sp) 310.0 kPa stays under the `C_PRS_IM_SP_MAX` ceiling 35000.0 kPa (margin 34690.0 kPa)
findings.title: Boost vs calibrated ceiling

findings.message: logged PUT-minus-ambient peaks 1886 hPa, under the `IP_PUT_AMP_DIF_MAX_PRS_DIF_THR` P0234 threshold 2700 hPa (margin 814 hPa)
